name: Continue
title: continue.dev
shortDescription: Continue is designed to enhance the capabilities of developers by integrating AI-driven code completion into their existing development environments. It offers open-source IDE extensions and a hub for custom AI code assistants, making it ideal for organizations looking to boost productivity without replacing their developers. An example use case is a developer using Continue to autocomplete code efficiently in various programming languages, thereby speeding up project timelines.
pros: Customizable to fit specific development environments
cons: May require initial setup and customization
Dependent on the quality of the AI model
Potential learning curve for new users
